senses.gloss: m. (σιτώνης) corn-merchant, in gen. wholesale provision dealer, contrad. to חנוני shop-keeper, and בעל הבית the producer.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 3:13">Tosef. Dem. III, 13</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סִיטוֹנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 2:4">Dem. II, 4</cite> <he>הס׳ ומוכרי וכ׳</he> the wholesale provision merchants and the corn dealers.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:1">Kel. XII, 1</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 23:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIII</cite> <he>הסיטון</he>, v. <cite ref="A02022"><he>אַמְיַינְטוֹן</he></cite>.]
